cards.title: Top of the Ladder
cards.instruction: Carry yourself as the highest-status person present. Treat questions as requests for your approval.

cards.title: Brighter Side
cards.instruction: Meet every setback with even greater optimism.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'll decide how we handle this. The car won't start. Excellent chance for a walk.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: You can question the details after my decision. And a free shower!

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Brilliant. The shower's finally reached your feet.

mechanism: A grants increasingly optimistic interpretations and permissions as a failed journey gains rain and wet-foot setbacks.
confusable: Generic cheerful status is insufficient: each setback must cause greater optimism expressed through A authority over the next choice.
comparison: A travel discomfort scene differs from the other alternative performance collapse and improvised touring opportunity.
seedUse: Use D20-a canonical weather progression only as creative context; its protected single exception remains untouched and unapproved by this pair work.
